Title: Support for PostgreSQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL—Hyperscale (Citus) is now available

Body.Content:
Now you can migrate from on-premises instances of PostgreSQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL—Hyperscale (Citus) with minimal downtime by using Azure Database Migration Service, which performs resilient migrations of PostgreSQL data at scale and with high reliability. Provision an instance of Azure Database Migration Service using the Azure portal or via Azure CLI, and then create a migration project to perform the migration.

For more information about performing these migrations, see our service documentation.

Learn more about Azure Database Migration Service
